body: claimed: agent issue-27-solidcore-bench · 2026-11-08 UTC · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-27 / issue/27-solidcore-bench · plan: stage 2 of the dual-kernel agreement bench (stage 1 = boolean subtract + offset, landed in 68efb11) - add boolean union/intersection to the seam and bench them truck vs solidcore vs closed form; add a fillet/chamfer seam op (solidcore only - truck 0.4/0.6 has none, recorded as Unsupported, never as passing) benched against closed forms; corrupt-input rows for the new ops. No production path switched.

partial (stage 2) on issue/27-solidcore-bench · PR #289 (draft) · pinned by boolean_fixtures_agree_across_kernels, boolean_fixtures_agree_at_fine_tessellation, cube_blends_match_closed_form, concave_l_blends_match_closed_form, rim_rounds_match_pappus, not_yet_rim_chamfer_default_path_stays_a_finding, rim_chamfer_agrees_with_cone_on_arc_fix, seam_refuses_degenerate_blends_and_empty_booleans, port_stage2_degenerates_never_panic_and_match_pinned_verdicts · merges at the next cut · `Refs #27`, so the issue stays open.

Readings:
- **Union/intersect, truck vs solidcore vs closed form**: 4 new fixtures. solidcore's error is at most 7.6e-9 abs. truck's is at most 3.4e-2 at default tolerance and closes to at most 5.7e-3 in the heavy lane (10x finer). Bounding boxes agree within 1.5e-5.
- **Blends (solidcore only; truck has no fillet, so it is Unsupported and recorded as not yet, never counted as agreement)**: 11 fixtures within 1e-6 relative. They are cube round/chamfer on 1/4/12 edges (spherical and bevel corners included), concave L-block round/chamfer, cylinder top/both rims, and a hole rim on a boolean result.
- **Not yet**: the circular-rim chamfer on the port's default path misses by 1.9e-6 rel (upstream WR-421). The opt-in `fillet_chamfer_cone_on_arc` fix brings it to 4e-8. Both cases are pinned.
- **Port finding**: `box & empty` returns the whole box as a valid solid. The seam now refuses empty operands. `box & disjoint box` returns `Ok` non-solid, which the seam turns into `Err`. The port panicked on none of the degenerate inputs.
- Heavy lane green in release. clippy -D warnings clean. `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p camcraft-kernel` passes.

Remaining for the gate: a solidcore-side importer corpus (STEP stays on truck-stepio), the wasm CI job, a healing bench, the first production consumer switched behind the bench, and upstream reports for the pinned findings.
PR #289 merged as a partial step (`Refs #27`), so this issue stays open for the remaining work listed above; `in-review` removed (no open PR for it now).
